Priya R (CS): Heads-up — Verdant Health renewal next week. They asked for a one-paragraph summary of SLO compliance for the last 90 days, a short note on any incidents that affected latency, and a clear statement of whether they9re due credits. Can someone own the numbers + customer phrasing?
Liam K (Ops): I9ll grab the metrics and do the credit calc. Propose a freeze 24h before the sync.
Sofia M (Customer): They want non-technical language. Bullet list or single paragraph is fine. Also please include the precise credit % if any.
Ravi D (Eng): FYI: on 2026-03-03 we had a burst of retries after a model rollout that increased p95 for ~35m while caches warmed. We rolled the config back and re-deployed a fix.
uptime-bot: Snapshot ready: https://dash.internal/verdant/90d (snapshot id snap-20260305-0815).
Liam K (Ops): Preliminary (pre-freeze) numbers: uptime=99.913% over 90d, p50=95ms, p95=520ms. Under our SLO bands that maps to the [99.9%,99.95%) bucket => 0.25% credit for one billing month. Will verify with raw numerator/denominator.
Priya R (CS): Thank you. Could you draft the customer sentence? Keep it friendly and short, e.g.:\n"Over the past 90 days, Redwood delivered 99.91% uptime. This falls within the contract tier that entitles Verdant Health to a one-time credit equal to 0.25% of one month9s committed usage. We also observed a short latency increase on 2026-03-03; engineering mitigations and a permanent fix were completed the following day."\nSofia M (Customer): That sounds good. Add a 1-line plain-English cause from engineering.
Ravi D (Eng): One-liner: \"A model rollout caused increased retries and cache warm-up on 2026-03-03; we reverted the rollout and applied a fix by 2026-03-04.\"
Priya R (CS): Great. Liam, please attach a tiny transparency table with numerator/denominator and the contract tiers for the email. Example block below is fine:
```
Period: 90 days
Observed uptime: 99.913% (8732146 / 8736000 successful checks)
Contract tiers: >=99.95% = no credit; [99.9%,99.95%) = 0.25% credit
Result: eligible for 0.25% credit of one month committed usage
```
Liam K (Ops): Will include exact counts. Final numbers locked after 24h freeze (deadline 2026-03-06 09:00 PT).
Priya R (CS): Perfect. I9ll draft the renewal slide & email and tag you both for a quick sign-off. Target to send to Verdant the morning of 2026-03-07. Thanks :white_check_mark:
